aiTransparency.body: We believe in being upfront about how AI is used to build and create this experience.
aiTransparency.heading: AI transparency
points: Coding: this app is built with AI coding tools, including Lovable and Claude Code.
Water sounds: generated with ElevenLabs.io and combined with mixed Creative Commons sounds from freesound.org.
Images: generated and processed using Gemini, Nano Banana, and Adobe Firefly.
Our stance: AI is a tool for expression and implementation. The underlying ideas are ours, and we never let AI make the creative decisions.

disclaimer.heading: Disclaimer
points: This app is provided for entertainment purposes only.
It does not offer, and must not be relied on for, any financial, medical, health, or wellbeing benefit or advice.
Nothing in the app constitutes professional advice; consult a qualified professional for financial, medical, or health matters.
The app is provided "as is", without warranties of any kind, and to the maximum extent permitted by law, Alexander Forselius accepts no liability for any loss, injury, or damage arising from its use.

documentation.body: Curious about the theory behind Aquafulness — digital bathing, the sine-oscillation theory, and why watching waves is designed to feel calming? Read the full case study.
documentation.heading: Documentation

intro.body: Aquafulness is a calming, browser-based ocean wave visualization created for personal relaxation and ambient viewing. It is an independent hobby project, not a commercial product, and not a medical device.
intro.heading: About this app

openSource.body: Several pieces of amazing free and open source software made Aquafulness possible. As some of them require a link or license to be included, we want to honor all the amazing software that made this app possible.
openSource.heading: Open source software

product.body: Aquafulness is free, ad-free entertainment software: an interactive 3D ocean scene that runs in your browser using WebGL. It requires no installation, no account, and no payment, and it does not connect to any external service beyond the hosting platform described in the Privacy Policy below.

privacy.intro: This page explains, in plain terms, what happens to your data when you use Aquafulness.

contact.body: For any question about this privacy policy, contact Alexander Forselius at drsounds@gmail.com.
contact.heading: Questions

localStorage.body: Aquafulness uses your browser's local storage to remember your settings and personalize your experience — for example your chosen language, wave and camera preferences, and saved presets. This data stays on your device, is never transmitted to Alexander Forselius or any third party, and can be erased at any time by clearing your browser's site data for this app.
localStorage.heading: Local storage

thirdParty.body: Aquafulness does not embed third-party advertising, tracking pixels, or social media widgets of its own.
thirdParty.heading: Third parties

tracking.heading: Data collection and tracking
points: Aquafulness itself does not track, collect, or sell any personal data.

The app is hosted on Lovable, whose platform applies its own standard hosting and infrastructure logging, and may enable anonymized usage analytics (such as Google Analytics) as part of its standard service — this is configured by the hosting platform, not by the app's operator, and is not used to identify you personally.
No account is required and the app itself never asks you for personal information.
